column1: # Strings this fork adds on top of the pinned craft-i18n catalog (zh-hans).
# Merged after locales/zh-hans/photocraft.tsv of craft-i18n; a key keeps its first row, so
# these only fill the gaps. Remove a row once upstream carries the translation.

column2: Click a marker to move it; Alt-drag copies it; Shift-click picks several to align. Its size appears here once one is picked.
column3: 单击标记即可移动；按住 Alt 拖动可复制；按住 Shift 单击可多选以便对齐。选中一个标记后，它的尺寸会显示在这里。

column2: Drag Toolbar out of its dock
column3: 按住可把工具栏拖出停靠位置

column2: No layer under this marker. Select the layer in the Layers panel and press Bind Layer again.
column3: 此标记下方没有图层。请在“图层”面板中选中图层，再按一次“绑定图层”。

column2: Select the content to change with the Rectangular Marquee, then press Add from Selection.
column3: 用矩形选框选中要修改的内容，然后点“从选区添加”。

column2: Set this marker back to red without re-taking its snapshot
column3: 把此标记改回红色，但不重新拍摄快照

column2: Set this marker green without comparing pixels
column3: 把此标记标为绿色，不比较像素
